en_title: MindsEye Dev Build a Rocket Boy Says Legal Action Against 'Several Third Parties' Will Help It Pay Off Its Mountain of Debt
cn_title: 《MindsEye》开发商Build a Rocket Boy称，针对「多个第三方」采取法律行动将帮助其偿还巨额债务
opus_summary: 《MindsEye》开发商Build a Rocket Boy进入破产管理程序，总债务达6170万英镑(约合人民币5亿元)，其中3640万英镑(约合人民币3亿元)欠网易。公司计划对其指控的相关人员提起诉讼，以筹集资金偿债；管理人提案称，针对「多个第三方」的调查是破产管理中最大的资产。

paragraphs.en: After the disastrous release of MindsEye , its collapsed developer, Build a Rocket Boy (BARB), is attempting to pay off its mountain of debt via legal action against “saboteurs” who it alleged contributed to the game's downfall.
paragraphs.cn: 《MindsEye》灾难性地推出后，其已倒闭的开发商Build a Rocket Boy（BARB）正试图通过对「破坏者」采取法律行动，偿还巨额债务。该公司声称这些人导致了游戏的失败。

paragraphs.en: Story-driven action adventure game MindsEye was initially designed to be a part of Everywhere, the ‘Roblox for adults’ creation platform led by former Grand Theft Auto design chief Leslie Benzies. BARB eventually switched to focus on MindsEye, with the company ballooning in size to over 500 staff at peak.
paragraphs.cn: 剧情驱动的动作冒险游戏《MindsEye》最初被设计为《Everywhere》的一部分。《Everywhere》是一个被称为「成人版Roblox」的创作平台，由《侠盗猎车手》前设计主管Leslie Benzies主导。BARB最终转而专注于《MindsEye》，公司规模迅速膨胀，员工人数在高峰期超过500人。

paragraphs.en: But MindsEye flopped hard when it came out in June 2025, with players calling it "broken," "buggy," and "the worst game of 2025." Soon after, BARB said it was “heartbroken” over the issues players had faced with the game , and promised to release a series of patches to fix the significant performance problems, glitches, and AI behavior bugs. Amid sweeping layoffs, Benzies told staff that the studio would bounce back and relaunch MindsEye, blaming its struggles on internal and external "saboteurs," among other things. CEO Mark Gerhard said the studio had been investigating what he called “criminal activity” that took place around the launch of the game.
paragraphs.cn: 但《MindsEye》于2025年6月推出后遭遇惨败，玩家称其「坏得一塌糊涂」、「漏洞百出」，是「2025年最差游戏」。不久后，BARB表示对玩家在游戏中遇到的问题「心碎不已」，并承诺推出一系列补丁，修复严重的性能问题、故障和AI行为漏洞。在大规模裁员之际，Benzies告诉员工，工作室将重振旗鼓并重新推出《MindsEye》，他将其困境归咎于内部和外部的「破坏者」等因素。首席执行官Mark Gerhard表示，工作室一直在调查游戏发售前后发生的、他所称的「犯罪活动」。

paragraphs.en: However, in September this year it was reported that the Edinburgh-based company faced closure, with BARB slipping into administration. Today, on the eve of GTA 6's launch, an administrators’ proposal went live on BARB’s Companies House page — spotted by RedbullCola on ResetEra , (thanks Kotaku ). The proposal details what BARB owes and to who, as well as how it plans to cover its debts.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，今年9月有报道称，这家总部位于爱丁堡的公司面临关闭，BARB进入了破产管理程序。今天，在《GTA6》发售前夕，一份破产管理人方案发布在BARB的英国公司注册处页面上——这一方案由ResetEra上的RedbullCola发现（感谢Kotaku）。该方案详细列出了BARB所欠债务及债权人，以及其计划如何偿还债务。

paragraphs.en: The total debt comes to £61.7 million (approx. $81.2 million). The bulk of the debt belongs to NetEase (£36.4 million, approx. $47.9 million). NetEase is a major investor in BARB, having participated in multiple funding rounds including a $110 million Series D round in January 2024. According to company documents , BARB brought in more than £233 million (approx. $306 million) of investment by 2024. £19.90 (approx. $25... yes, $25!) is owed to ChatGPT company OpenAI.
paragraphs.cn: 债务总额达到6170万英镑（约合8120万美元）。其中大部分债务欠网易（3640万英镑，约合4790万美元）。网易是BARB的主要投资者，参与过多轮融资，包括2024年1月的1.1亿美元D轮融资。根据公司文件，截至2024年，BARB获得了超过2.33亿英镑（约合3.06亿美元）的投资。BARB还欠ChatGPT所属公司OpenAI 19.90英镑（约合25美元……没错，25美元！）。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, BARB co-CEO Mark Gerhard claimed the studio was a victim of corporate espionage and "saboteurs." The company will now pursue litigation against the people it accused in a bid to gather the money and pay off the debts. Gerhard had pinned the blame on a YouTube and TikTok management agency called Ritual Network, accusing it of tarnishing BARB’s reputation in a coordinated propaganda campaign. Ritual Network has denied all allegations that it orchestrated a $1 million smear campaign against MindsEye.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，BARB联合首席执行官Mark Gerhard声称，该工作室是商业间谍活动和「破坏者」的受害者。该公司现在将对其指控的人员提起诉讼，试图筹集资金偿还债务。Gerhard此前将责任归咎于一家名为Ritual Network的YouTube和TikTok管理机构，指控该机构通过一场有组织的宣传活动损害BARB的声誉。Ritual Network否认了有关其策划了一场耗资100万美元的针对《MindsEye》的抹黑行动的所有指控。

paragraphs.en: The proposal claims BARB’s investigations against “a number of third parties” are “the largest asset of the administration,” so it seems like all hopes at the company of paying off the debt are tied to litigation being successful.
paragraphs.cn: 该方案称，BARB针对「多个第三方」的调查是「破产管理程序中最大的资产」，因此，该公司偿还债务的全部希望似乎都寄托在诉讼成功上。

paragraphs.en: In May, Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, issued what sounded like a nod to BARB’s struggles . "Making hits seems to get harder and harder and harder as entertainment industries mature," Zelnick said, speaking at the TD Cowen 54th Annual Technology, Media & Telecom Conference.
paragraphs.cn: 5月，Rockstar母公司Take-Two的老板Strauss Zelnick发表了一番言论，听起来似乎暗指BARB的困境。「随着娱乐产业逐渐成熟，打造热门作品似乎变得越来越、越来越、越来越难，」Zelnick在TD Cowen第54届年度科技、媒体与电信会议上说道。

paragraphs.en: "The folks at Rockstar seem to be able to make these massive hits, and lots of other people have tried. Lots and lots, including former Rockstar employees. And so far, they haven't been able to do it."
paragraphs.cn: 「Rockstar的员工似乎能够打造这些大获成功的作品，而其他很多人也尝试过。非常非常多人，包括Rockstar的前员工。但到目前为止，他们还没能做到。」
